But the Houston Rockets newcomer showed another side of his game at practice, and it had a distinctly Michael Jackson flavor. Smart broke out his best King of Pop impersonation during a recent Rockets practice, showing off dance moves that quickly caught the attention of fans online. The veteran guard traded his usual defensive intensity for some rhythm, reminding everyone that there is more to his personality than steals, hustle plays and hard-nosed defense. The moment offered a lighthearted glimpse of Houston’s locker-room atmosphere as the Rockets prepare for the 2026-27 NBA season.

articles.title: Ryan Garcia clashes with Adrien Broner over a potential Gervonta Davis rematch
articles.summary: Ryan Garcia wanted support for a potential rematch with Gervonta “Tank” Davis. Instead, he got a reality check from Adrien Broner — and the exchange quickly turned heated. During Broner’s livestream on Kick, Garcia challenged the former four-division world champion over his belief that Davis would beat him again. Broner did not hesitate to make his position clear, telling Garcia that “he smokes you,” according to reports covering the confrontation. Garcia visibly took exception to the prediction. The argument escalated as the two boxers traded words, with singer Ray J attempting to intervene at one point. In footage circulating online, Garcia appears to push Ray J aside as the confrontation intensifies.

articles.title: CeeDee Lamb’s epic full-back tattoo is back in the spotlight, and the process was intense
articles.summary: CeeDee Lamb is accustomed to taking hits on the football field, but one of his most intense experiences away from the Dallas Cowboys came in a tattoo studio. A resurfaced video showing Lamb getting an enormous, custom-designed tattoo across his entire back is attracting attention again, reminding NFL fans of the extraordinary commitment behind the wide receiver's body art. The session took place in the summer of 2025, when Lamb underwent an eight-plus-hour tattoo process that involved four artists working on his back at the same time. The result was far more than a small tribute or a simple piece of artwork. Lamb's back became a sprawling mural featuring the late NBA legend Kobe Bryant, a Black Mamba, a tiger and a Spartan, with the imagery reflecting themes associated with the basketball icon and Lamb's own competitive identity.
